svg.desc: The complete scientific record, newest first and unclamped: the same entry component as the campaign-page panel with the line clamp removed and no height cap.

g.text: LAB NOTEBOOK — FULL RECORD
<37> entries
reflection
hypothesis
decision
observation
Two of three vetoes were right — the Sn-rich family sits 0.2 eV above the window and the critic caught it before
any compute was spent. The one it got wrong (ZnGeP₂) still scored inside the gap window, so the veto cost us a
candidate rather than a relaxation. Next iteration should push on Cd-for-Zn substitution, where both hits came from.
Chalcopyrite Cu–In–Se derivatives should land near 1.3 eV if the Ga fraction stays under a third — worth two
relaxations this iteration, and a literature check on the Cd analogue before proposing more of the family.
Spend what is left of the relaxation budget on Cd-for-Zn substitutions only. The Sn branch is closed for this
campaign: three of four Sn candidates came back off-target and the fourth failed to converge.
AlSb's reduced formula matches a hold-out entry masked from MP search, so it is flagged as a rediscovery
rather than a hit — the campaign found the textbook answer without being able to look it up.
Same entry component as the campaign-page panel (§3.8), with -webkit-line-clamp removed and no height cap. Newest first, unclamped,
one continuous scroll — this page is the campaign's scientific record, and nothing on it is truncated.
